title: Understanding KDE Curves
text: A KDE (Kernel Density Estimate) curve is a way to estimate the probability density function of a random variable. It should be smooth and continuous. Look for any anomalies in the curves that might indicate an issue.

title: Analyzing the Axes
text: Check the x-axis and y-axis of each plot. A valid KDE curve should have a reasonable range for the data it represents. Does any plot have an unusual range?

title: Identifying the Anomaly
text: Which plot has an unusual range or shape that doesn't fit the expected distribution of the data?
